dish.title: Malian Chicken Maafe: Peanut and Tomato Stew with Sweet Potatoes
dish.description: West African groundnut stew: chicken thighs simmered in a rich sauce of peanut butter, tomato paste, onion, garlic, and ginger with a whole Scotch bonnet for gentle heat, sweet potatoes, and carrots. Served over white rice.

recipe_version.title: Malian Chicken Maafe: Peanut and Tomato Stew with Sweet Potatoes
recipe_version.description: West African groundnut stew: chicken thighs simmered in a rich sauce of peanut butter, tomato paste, onion, garlic, and ginger with a whole Scotch bonnet for gentle heat, sweet potatoes, and carrots. Served over white rice.

ingredients.name: natural creamy peanut butter
ingredients.display_name: natural creamy peanut butter whose label lists peanuts and salt only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the chicken into large pieces and season with 1 tsp salt. Chop the onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. Peel and cut the sweet potatoes and carrots. Rinse the rice and chop the cilantro.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high and brown the chicken in two batches, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, and tomato paste and cook, stirring, until the paste darkens, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the peanut sauce
steps.body: Whisk the peanut butter with 1 cup of the water until smooth, then stir it into the pot with the remaining 3 cups water, 1 tsp salt, the whole Scotch bonnet, and the bay leaves. Return the chicken.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Bring to a simmer, partly cover, and cook 15 minutes, stirring the bottom often. Add the sweet potatoes and carrots and simmer until tender and the sauce is thick and glossy, about 20 minutes more.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: When the vegetables go in, combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered. This runs inside step 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the Scotch bonnet and bay leaves. Ladle the maafe over or beside the rice and scatter cilantro.
